note: Each card is one possible mitosis: clicked, found by the detector, or both (see the label). First decide whether it is a division (1 = division, 2 = not a division, 3 = unsure), then tick every error you see, call HLA-G, and type the metaphase frame (Fiji numbering, shown on each tile as f#+1). Labels marked 'suggested' are the detector's hints, not calls. Each card runs from 1 h before to 9 h after the event (her binucleation calls can resolve ~7 h later), 4 cards a part. Channels: H2B red, ZO1 green; HLA-G (AF647, magenta) starts off -- tick it at the top to call HLA-G.
